title: 2020 HMMT February Geometry Problem 5
statement: Let \(A B C D E F\) be a regular hexagon with side length 2. A circle with radius 3 and center at \(A\) is drawn. Find the area inside quadrilateral \(B C D E\) but outside the circle.

solutions.text:
Rotate the region 6 times about \(A\) to form a bigger hexagon with a circular hole. The larger hexagon has side length 4 and area \(24 \sqrt{3}\), so the area of the region is \(\frac{1}{6}(24 \sqrt{3}-9 \pi)=4 \sqrt{3}-\frac{3}{2} \pi\).
